35.text: The proofs of God's existence, however, can predispose one to faith and help one to see that faith is not opposed to reason.
35.notes: Sentence only, not the whole paragraph. Final sentence; vatican.va IntraText prints '(so) the proofs' with lowercase t, an OCR artifact. Earlier sentences: reason can know a personal God; intimacy requires revelation and grace. Ch. 12 line 27.
